upstream_provenance.source_context:
# Observe native playback events instead of inferring success from Dart intent

## Platform difference

Requested play/volume state and wrapper initialization can diverge from actual native playback behavior.

## Implementation

Simple Live adds AVPlayer START_RENDER_FRAME events, correlates texture/generation and times out first-frame waiting; its failover strategy then tries remaining CDN lines. KikoFlu guards stale indices/completion and uses an OH pause-after-load/play sequence to recover a completed-state transition. PiliPlus removes a cached requested-volume equality gate and exposes observed volume when selected.

## Applicability

The first-frame bridge is OH-specific; the volume reconciliation change is shared behavior relevant to the same boundary. Exact deadlines and CDN choices are application policy.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

A stale event from an old player must not confirm the new stream. A timer or isPlaying flag alone does not prove visible video. Recoveries must not loop indefinitely or silently change user intent.

## Verification

Test delayed/no first frame, rapid stream switches, completion-to-replay, rejected native commands and external volume changes while logging request and observation identities.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
